steps: Visit the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer during office hours to request a hard copy of the application form.
Fill in all mandatory fields in the application form and attach copies of mandatory documents.
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer.
Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer containing submission details.
parsed.department: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu
